title: Preparing a Production Build knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which principle is most useful when applying Preparing a Production Build?
options: reproduce a problem, inspect the built CSS and test output rather than guessing
It removes the need to understand HTML semantics, the CSS cascade or browser behavior.
It makes every interface responsive and accessible without testing.
It runs all utility classes as JavaScript in the browser.
questions.answer_key: reproduce a problem, inspect the built CSS and test output rather than guessing
questions.explanation: Preparing a Production Build is best understood through the syllabus topics: Understanding the build command, Generating final CSS assets, Checking application output. Choose the technique deliberately and verify the result.

questions.prompt: Which workflow is strongest when working with preparing a production build?
options: Add classes until a screenshot looks acceptable without inspecting generated CSS.
Assume that starting a development server proves every page and state works.
Skip narrow-screen testing because utility-first CSS is automatically responsive.
use a minimal test case and confirm the production build and responsive states
questions.answer_key: use a minimal test case and confirm the production build and responsive states
questions.explanation: A reliable workflow checks generated CSS and the actual interface. Related topics include: Understanding the build command, Generating final CSS assets, Checking application output, Verifying production stylesheet links.

questions.prompt: Which common mistake should you avoid when applying preparing a production build?
options: Use the official documentation for version-specific behavior.
Check keyboard states where controls are involved.
a successful development server does not prove production assets are complete
Document intended behavior and test representative content.
questions.answer_key: a successful development server does not prove production assets are complete
questions.explanation: Good styling work is verified, version-aware and tested with realistic content and input methods.
